context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles a Copilot review with clean=false: addresses every comment before proceeding, uses the prescribed scripts for re-requesting review and awaiting results, and only merges when clean=true.

checklist.name: Addresses both comments
checklist.description: The plan describes addressing both review comments (the guard logic change AND the missing test case), not just one

checklist.name: No selective skipping
checklist.description: The plan does NOT propose ignoring or deferring any comment (e.g. does not say 'this comment is minor' or 'I'll handle it later')

checklist.name: Re-request via script
checklist.description: After pushing the fix, the plan calls `python3 scripts/request_copilot_review.py 47` (or equivalent PR number) to re-request the review

checklist.name: Await review again via script
checklist.description: After re-requesting, the plan calls `python3 scripts/await_copilot_review.py 47` to wait for the next review result

checklist.name: Merge conditioned on clean=true
checklist.description: The plan explicitly states it will only call merge when the subsequent review returns `"clean": true`

checklist.name: Merge via script
checklist.description: Merge is performed with `python3 scripts/merge_pr.py 47` (not gh pr merge or git merge)

checklist.name: Repeat loop if still not clean
checklist.description: The plan describes that if the second review also returns clean=false, the fix-request-await cycle repeats — it does not merge unconditionally after one round

checklist.name: No premature merge
checklist.description: The plan does NOT include a merge step before the second `await_copilot_review.py` result is confirmed as clean

checklist.name: Full suite run before re-request
checklist.description: The plan runs `python3 scripts/run_tests.py` (full suite) after making code changes and before re-requesting the review
